title: Chapter 93
text:
Fusion successful. You have developed [Electromagnetic Scanning Tactical Goggles]!

"Oh?"

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. This was not what he wanted, but it was useful for snipers. It was more accurate than thermal imaging and could scan the interior of a building through walls. If it was used on a scope, it would be very accurate to shoot through walls.

"One more time."

This time, you have used 30,000 experience.

Fusion successful. You have developed [Electromagnetic Pulse Jammer]!

"This is it." Han Xiao nodded. There were many blueprints for this combination, and the Electromagnetic Pulse Jammer was a very common blueprint. The probability of it being dropped was very high. Other than the Electromagnetic Pulse Jammer, there were several blueprints that could meet his requirements. He had originally prepared the experience for the third fusion, but this saved him a lot of experience.

Electromagnetic Pulse Jammer, this thing was famous. It was MMP … no, EMP.

There was no shortage of vehicles in the desert. As a sniper, distance was the key. An anti-vehicle jammer was indispensable.

Right, he still lacked some high-power bombs, mines, and traps.

Touching his chin, Han Xiao's eyes suddenly lit up. He had a new idea.

"This time, I don't seem to need fusion. I can try to create it myself!"

In the past, the players had limited use of the self-creation function. However, he could truly understand the knowledge and combine it with the principles of other blueprints to create new blueprints. He could use his own knowledge to supplement the various details of the concept. Through the self-creation function, he could skip the long research and development process. Perhaps he could even research some powerful blueprints in advance.

The core principle of high-explosive ammunition was a very flammable gas. If this gas was compressed into a larger container, the power would also increase. It would not be inferior to a fragmentation mine.

Since he wanted to make explosive mines, he needed to add gunpowder and bullets. Thus, he had to consider the ignition method of the sealed high-explosive gas. Han Xiao thought about it and decided to divide the interior of the bomb. The high-explosive gas and inert gas would be neutralized and sealed in one layer. He would leave a mechanism that would be arranged as a delay trigger. When the time was up, it would automatically open. When the gas leaked into the gunpowder, it would directly ignite and explode.

However, since he was going to create it himself, Han Xiao felt that he might as well add in the power of the finished product and add the principle of the Hayme bomb.

Let's do it!

Han Xiao quickly perfected his thought process and began to manufacture it. Self-created machines had to be completed first before the success of the self-created machines could be determined. Since the players had to set up the concept route, put in the materials and parts, choose the tools, and then start the loading bar, the success rate was completely dependent on luck.

On the other hand, Han Xiao was personally involved in all aspects of the manufacturing process and could make minor adjustments at any stage. The success rate was on a completely different level.

Soon, a metal disk-shaped mine with a diameter of about 30 centimeters was created. He opened the interface and activated the Self-Created Judgment.

[Determining blueprint creation …]

Judgment Failed.

"It actually failed." Han Xiao frowned slightly.

Failure of judgment must be due to the machine not being able to achieve the desired effect, or there was an obvious flaw.

He found a place to test the power of the first product and found that there was a problem with the ignition of the high-flammable gas, gunpowder shrapnel, and poison gas. It exploded, but the power was not as expected, so he had to modify it again.

It was very difficult to control the gas. Even the slightest mistake had to be redone, and the machinery had to be perfected again and again. The testing ground of the Fabian Organization's stronghold, which was used to test the power of the weapons, was charred black and filled with poisonous gas. Even he had no choice but to retreat, or else his health would continue to drop.

Finally, after the thirteenth failure, a heavenly notification sound came from the interface.

Judgment Successful. You have created your own blueprint!

The blueprint of a new type of bomb appeared in his mind, and the interface automatically recorded all the principles behind it. Han Xiao looked at the effect and muttered, "Then let's call it the High-Flammable Poison Time-Delay Bomb … It's too boring. Let's call it the Poison Deflagration Bomb!"

Naming Successful. You have received the blueprint [Poison Deflagration Bomb]!

Once the blueprint was recognized by the interface, it became a skill. The level of the blueprint could be increased through experience, and the parameters could be clearly understood. With the reference of the template, the production speed would be much faster.

Just as I thought, the function of the self-created blueprint is suitable for my situation. There is a huge potential to be discovered. Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

The next step is to create a sufficient number of bombs.

…

It was nighttime.

Han Xiao drove to an empty area, where he set off a row of fireworks and set them off with a delay. After that, he went to the route that Rose Militant had to take to reach this area. He set up traps, planted jammers, and planted Poison Deflagration Bombs.

How could he be sure that this was the only route?

Hmm … Have you ever heard of the shortest line between two points?

Of course, he did not rule out the possibility that the enemy would take a detour. Even if that happened, he would not lose anything. At most, he would not be able to ambush them.

The EMP jammer was a cylindrical device with a base. Han Xiao had created a portable model. It was about one meter tall and had a radiation radius of three hundred meters. It emitted high-frequency electromagnetic signals that interfered with precision instruments and electronic components. Its targets included communication devices, electronic control devices, and detection radars. It was very effective against vehicles. It could affect the electronic control system of the vehicle, such as sensors and controllers, and cause the vehicle to malfunction.

Although Han Xiao did not think that Rose Militant's vehicle was anti-EMP, he adjusted the jammer's power to a very high level for safety reasons. This way, if the vehicle was not covered with anti-EMP metal, it would be hit by the jammer even if there was a small gap. The price was that the jammer's energy consumption was very high. A high-energy battery that cost two thousand dollars would be depleted in ten seconds. However, it did not matter much. The jammer did not need to continuously release EMP. As long as the first wave of attack was completed, the effect would be the same.

After setting up the trap, he parked the off-road vehicle behind a sand dune, about four hundred meters away from the trap. Then, he quietly crouched on the ground and aimed with the Red Falcon like a patient hunter.

The temperature of the desert at night dropped drastically. The cold wind blew the sand and dust. Han Xiao wrapped himself in a high-collared windbreaker and thick leather gloves to prevent the cold from affecting his accuracy.

Boom!

Dozens of fireworks shot into the sky from the preset area. They were extremely eye-catching in the night sky. Even from a dozen kilometers away, they could be seen clearly.

…

"Something's happening!"

In the base of Rose Militant, the lookout saw the fireworks and quickly reported it to Luo Qing.

Luo Qing quickly ordered, "Dorothy, bring some men to check it out. Be careful of the other armed groups. If they are attacked, send out a distress signal immediately."

Dorothy nodded and selected twenty mercenaries. They quickly put on their tactical suits and filled their pockets with various magazines and grenades. Then, they boarded four off-road vehicles and left.

In the base of Couton Mercenary Organization, Couton also saw the fireworks. He coldly said, "Send someone to check it out. There might be a fight. Bring everyone."

Armed off-road vehicles drove out of Couton's base one after another.

The same scene was happening in the other bases of the other forces that could see the fireworks.

…

The off-road vehicles of Rose Militant sped forward. The tires kicked up sand and left a long trail behind them.

"Instructor Dorothy, do you think that this is a sign that Felonia is about to appear?" a female mercenary asked.

Dorothy looked ferocious. When she pursed her lips, she looked like a black tiger that was about to devour its prey. Her eyes were filled with murderous intent. She coldly snorted and said, "Humph, if Felonia was so easy to find, we wouldn't have wasted two years here. This time, I think someone is messing with us. Everyone, be on high alert. Maybe it's another trap set by Couton!"

Vroom!

As soon as she finished speaking, a strange electric current sounded in the air. Dorothy's superhuman senses detected a special wave spreading from not far away. At the same time, the dashboards of the vehicles crackled with sparks. The four off-road vehicles suddenly lost control and crashed into each other like drunkards. No matter how hard the drivers stepped on the accelerator, they could not move.

"Enemy attack!" Dorothy was shocked. She looked around cautiously.

What had paralyzed their vehicles? Could it be an EMP?

The mercenaries hurriedly looked around. All they could see was the yellow sand under the night sky. There was nothing unusual.

The desert was vast and empty. The starry river could be seen in the night sky. A bleak night breeze blew past.

The group of Rose Militant mercenaries felt goosebumps on their arms. It was as if a huge hand was choking them. The pressure was suffocating.

Bam!

One of the Rose Militant mercenaries was sent flying by the huge force. She landed on the yellow sand with a loud thud and no longer made a sound. There was a bloody hole in her chest.

"There's a sniper. Hide behind the car!" Dorothy was shocked and angry. She hurriedly asked her teammates to hide behind the car. She then took out a distress flare and shot it into the sky. The white light illuminated the night sky.

The mercenaries of Rose Militant were slightly relieved. The base was very close. As long as they could hold on for fifteen minutes, reinforcements would arrive!

Han Xiao, who was lying on the sand dune, looked up at the distress flare. He clicked his tongue and said, "So this is a cloud-piercing arrow that can summon thousands of soldiers? The picture is the picture of clothes. "

He changed to a high-explosive cartridge and shot at the location where the Burning Poison Grenades were buried. The bullet landed and ignited a flame, burning the Burning Poison Grenades that were buried under the sand.

"Boom!"

With a loud bang, a sea of fire surged up. The other mines that Han Xiao had buried triggered a chain reaction. They exploded one after another!

The flames engulfed four vehicles and mixed with a thick poisonous gas. The interface was filled with the continuous damage of poison and burning.

The Hayme Bullet was a type of poisonous gas bullet. It was also known as the 'Hayme Bullet of Justice.' Its principle was applied to the Burning Poison Grenades, which made its power more versatile.

Coughing sounds could be heard continuously. Dorothy felt disgusted and frustrated. Her ordinary teammates were even worse. They felt dizzy and vomited.

If they continued to stay where they were, they would either be burned to death or poisoned to death!
